svg.text: SSR framework for Bun + React 19 · from build to boot, request → SSR → hydration → soft‑nav, to shutdown
cors ⋅ csp ⋅ auth ⋅ logging — wraps the whole dispatch
check fast paths, else fall through to SSR
document & /_data run the SAME gate = auth contract
Fast paths · first match wins → return early (bypass SSR)
global middleware still runs; per-route gate does NOT
405 on non-GET ⋅ same gate as document
graceful teardown · each server keeps its own hooks
Traced from packages/core/src — server/serve.ts · request-handler.ts · client/entry.tsx · ClientRouter.tsx · build/bundler.ts
